verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַמְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּי֖וֹם טָהֳרָת֑וֹ וְהוּבָ֖א אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tih·yeh tō·w·raṯ ham·mə·ṣō·rā‘ bə·yō·wm ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw wə·hū·ḇā ’el- hak·kō·hên
verses.literal: This is the law for the one afflicted with a skin disease on the day of his cleansing when he is brought to the priest
verses.literalPt: Esta será a lei do leproso no dia da sua purificação: será levado ao sacerdote,

verses.original: וְיָצָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְרָאָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְהִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע־ הַצָּרַ֖עַת מִן־ הַצָּרֽוּעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā hak·kō·hên ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·rā·’āh hak·kō·hên wə·hin·nêh nir·pā ne·ḡa‘- haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ min- haṣ·ṣā·rū·a‘
verses.literal: The priest . . . is to go outside the camp to examine him . . . and if the skin disease of the afflicted person has healed . . .
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote sairá fora do arraial, e o examinará, e eis que, se a praga da lepra do leproso for sarada,

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְלָקַ֧ח לַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי־ צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh hak·kō·hên wə·lā·qaḥ lam·miṭ·ṭa·hêr šə·tê- ṣip·po·rîm ḥay·yō·wṯ ṭə·hō·rō·wṯ wə·‘êṣ ’e·rez ū·šə·nî ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ wə·’ê·zōḇ
verses.literal: the priest shall order that two live clean birds cedar wood scarlet yarn . . . and hyssop be brought for the one to be cleansed
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote ordenará que por aquele que se houver de purificar se tomem duas aves vivas e limpas, e pau de cedro, e carmesim, e hissopo.

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הַצִּפּ֣וֹר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־ מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh hak·kō·hên wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣip·pō·wr hā·’e·ḥāṯ ’el- kə·lî- ḥe·reś ‘al- ma·yim ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Then the priest shall command that one of the birds be slaughtered over fresh water in a clay pot
verses.literalPt: Mandará também o sacerdote que se degole uma ave num vaso de barro sobre águas vivas,

verses.original: אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽחַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔הּ וְאֶת־ עֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וְאֶת־ שְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֶת־ הָאֵזֹ֑ב וְטָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜ם וְאֵ֣ת׀ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּ֗ה בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַמַּ֥יִם הַֽחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh yiq·qaḥ ’ō·ṯāh wə·’eṯ- ‘êṣ hā·’e·rez wə·’eṯ- šə·nî hat·tō·w·la·‘aṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ê·zōḇ wə·ṭā·ḇal ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’êṯ haṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh bə·ḏam haṣ·ṣip·pōr haš·šə·ḥu·ṭāh ‘al ham·ma·yim ha·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: And he is to take - the live bird together with the cedar wood scarlet yarn . . . and hyssop and dip them into the blood . . . of the bird that was slaughtered over the fresh water
verses.literalPt: E tomará a ave viva, e o pau de cedro, e o carmesim, e o hissopo, e os molhará, com a ave viva, no sangue da ave que foi degolada sobre as águas correntes.

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן־ הַצָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִ֣הֲר֔וֹ וְשִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽחַיָּ֖ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zāh ‘al ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr min- haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm wə·ṭi·hă·rōw wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Seven times he shall sprinkle . . . the one to be cleansed of the skin disease Then he shall pronounce him clean and release the live bird into the open field
verses.literalPt: E sobre aquele que há de purificar-se da lepra espargirá sete vezes; então o declarará por limpo, e soltará a ave viva sobre a face do campo.

verses.original: וְכִבֶּס֩ הַמִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֜יו וְגִלַּ֣ח אֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֗וֹ וְרָחַ֤ץ בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר וְאַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָשַׁ֛ב מִח֥וּץ לְאָהֳל֖וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵib·bes ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·ḡil·laḥ ’eṯ- kāl- śə·‘ā·rōw wə·rā·ḥaṣ bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·hêr wə·’a·ḥar yā·ḇō·w ’el- ham·ma·ḥă·neh wə·yā·šaḇ mi·ḥūṣ lə·’ā·ho·lōw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: The one being cleansed must wash his clothes shave off all his hair and bathe with water then he will be ceremonially clean Afterward he may enter . . . the camp but he must remain outside his tent for seven days
verses.literalPt: E aquele que tem de purificar-se lavará as suas vestes, e rapará todo o seu pêlo, e se lavará com água; assim será limpo; e depois entrará no arraial, porém, ficará fora da sua tenda por sete dias;

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֗וֹ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֤וֹ וְאֶת־ זְקָנוֹ֙ וְאֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ שְׂעָר֖וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְכִבֶּ֣ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֗יו וְרָחַ֧ץ אֶת־ בְּשָׂר֛וֹ בַּמַּ֖יִם וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î yə·ḡal·laḥ ’eṯ- kāl- śə·‘ā·rōw ’eṯ- rō·šōw wə·’eṯ- zə·qā·nōw wə·’êṯ gab·bōṯ ‘ê·nāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- śə·‘ā·rōw yə·ḡal·lê·aḥ wə·ḵib·bes ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·rā·ḥaṣ ’eṯ- bə·śā·rōw bam·ma·yim wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: On the seventh day . . . he must shave off all his hair his head his beard his eyebrows . . . and the rest of his hair . . . He must wash his clothes and bathe himself with water and he will be clean
verses.literalPt: E será que ao sétimo dia rapará todo o seu pêlo, a sua cabeça, e a sua barba, e as sobrancelhas; sim, rapará todo o pêlo, e lavará as suas vestes, e lavará a sua carne com água, e será limpo,

verses.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי־ כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ים וְכַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת־ שְׁנָתָ֖הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔מֶן וְלֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî yiq·qaḥ šə·nê- ḵə·ḇā·śîm tə·mî·mîm wə·ḵaḇ·śāh ’a·ḥaṯ baṯ- šə·nā·ṯāh tə·mî·māh ū·šə·lō·šāh ‘eś·rō·nîm sō·leṯ min·ḥāh bə·lū·lāh ḇaš·še·men wə·lōḡ ’e·ḥāḏ šā·men
verses.literal: On the eighth day he is to bring two unblemished male lambs an unblemished ewe lamb a year old . . . a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah . . . of fine flour mixed with olive oil and one log of olive oil
verses.literalPt: E ao oitavo dia tomará dois cordeiros sem defeito, e uma cordeira sem defeito, de um ano, e três dízimas de flor de farinha para oferta de alimentos, amassada com azeite, e um logue de azeite;

verses.original: וְהֶעֱמִ֞יד הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽמְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָאִ֥ישׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְאֹתָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·mîḏ hak·kō·hên ham·ṭa·hêr ’êṯ hā·’îš ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr wə·’ō·ṯām lip̄·nê Yah·weh pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The priest who performs the cleansing shall present the one to be cleansed together with these offerings before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote que faz a purificação apresentará o homem que houver de purificar-se, com aquelas coisas, perante o SENHOR, à porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֗ד וְהִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛וֹ לְאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hak·ke·ḇeś hā·’e·ḥāḏ wə·hiq·rîḇ ’ō·ṯōw lə·’ā·šām wə·’eṯ- lōḡ haš·šā·men wə·hê·nîp̄ ’ō·ṯām tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take one of the male lambs and present it as a guilt offering along with the log of olive oil and he must wave them as a wave offering before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará um dos cordeiros, e o oferecerá por expiação da culpa, e o logue de azeite; e os oferecerá por oferta movida perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֶת־ הַכֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת־ הַֽחַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה בִּמְק֣וֹם הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠חַטָּאת הָאָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hak·ke·ḇeś bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh bim·qō·wm haq·qō·ḏeš kî ka·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ hā·’ā·šām hū lak·kō·hên qō·ḏeš qā·ḏā·šîm hū
verses.literal: Then he is to slaughter the lamb in the sanctuary area where the sin offering and burnt offering are slaughtered Like the sin offering the guilt offering belongs to the priest it is most holy . . .
verses.literalPt: Então degolará o cordeiro no lugar em que se degola a oferta da expiação do pecado e o holocausto, no lugar santo; porque quer a oferta da expiação da culpa como a da expiação do pecado é para o sacerdote; coisa santíssima é.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח הַכֹּהֵן֮ מִדַּ֣ם הָאָשָׁם֒ וְנָתַן֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַל־ תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dam hā·’ā·šām wə·nā·ṯan hak·kō·hên ‘al- tə·nūḵ ’ō·zen ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen yā·ḏōw hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen raḡ·lōw hay·mā·nîṯ
verses.literal: The priest is to take some of the blood from the guilt offering and put it . . . on the right earlobe . . . of the one to be cleansed on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará do sangue da expiação da culpa, e o porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e no dedo polegar do seu pé direito.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֥ח הַכֹּהֵ֖ן מִלֹּ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְיָצַ֛ק עַל־ כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mil·lōḡ haš·šā·men wə·yā·ṣaq ‘al- kap̄ hak·kō·hên haś·śə·mā·lîṯ
verses.literal: Then the priest shall take some of the log of olive oil pour it into his left palm
verses.literalPt: Também o sacerdote tomará do logue de azeite, e o derramará na palma da sua própria mão esquerda.

verses.original: וְטָבַ֤ל הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ אֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭā·ḇal hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw hay·mā·nîṯ min- haš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap·pōw haś·śə·mā·lîṯ wə·hiz·zāh min- haš·še·men bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: dip his right forefinger into the oil in his left palm and sprinkle some of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote molhará o seu dedo direito no azeite que está na sua mão esquerda, e daquele azeite com o seu dedo espargirá sete vezes perante o SENHOR;

verses.original: וּמִיֶּ֨תֶר הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כַּפּ֗וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַכֹּהֵן֙ עַל־ תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî·ye·ṯer haš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap·pōw yit·tên hak·kō·hên ‘al- tə·nūḵ ’ō·zen ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen yā·ḏōw hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen raḡ·lōw hay·mā·nîṯ ‘al dam hā·’ā·šām
verses.literal: And the priest is to put some of the oil remaining in his palm on the right earlobe . . . of the one to be cleansed on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot on top of the blood of the guilt offering
verses.literalPt: E o restante do azeite, que está na sua mão, o sacerdote porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar do seu pé direito, em cima do sangue da expiação da culpa;

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר בַּשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯār baš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap̄ hak·kō·hên yit·tên ‘al- rōš ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed to make atonement for him before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o restante do azeite que está na mão do sacerdote, o porá sobre a cabeça daquele que tem de purificar-se; assim o sacerdote fará expiação por ele perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את וְכִפֶּ֕ר עַל־ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִטֻּמְאָת֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·ḵip·per ‘al- ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr miṭ·ṭum·’ā·ṯōw wə·’a·ḥar yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: Then the priest is to sacrifice the sin offering and make atonement for the one to be cleansed from his uncleanness After that the priest shall slaughter the burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Também o sacerdote fará a expiação do pecado, e fará expiação por aquele que tem de purificar-se da sua imundícia; e depois degolará o holocausto;

verses.original: וְהֶעֱלָ֧ה הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חָה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְטָהֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·he·‘ĕ·lāh hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- ham·min·ḥāh ham·miz·bê·ḥāh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: and offer it on the altar with the grain offering to make atonement for him and he will be clean
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote oferecerá o holocausto e a oferta de alimentos sobre o altar; assim o sacerdote fará expiação por ele, e será limpo.

verses.original: וְאִם־ דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְאֵ֣ין יָדוֹ֮ מַשֶּׂגֶת֒ וְ֠לָקַח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִתְנוּפָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְעִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּשֶּׁ֛מֶן לְמִנְחָ֖ה וְלֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- dal hū wə·’ên yā·ḏōw maś·śe·ḡeṯ wə·lā·qaḥ ke·ḇeś ’e·ḥāḏ ’ā·šām liṯ·nū·p̄āh lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw wə·‘iś·śā·rō·wn sō·leṯ ’e·ḥāḏ bā·lūl baš·še·men lə·min·ḥāh wə·lōḡ šā·men
verses.literal: If, however the person is poor and cannot afford these offerings . . . he is to take one male lamb as a guilt offering to be waved to make atonement for him along with a tenth of an ephah of fine flour . . . mixed with olive oil for a grain offering a log of olive oil
verses.literalPt: Porém se for pobre, e em sua mão não houver recursos para tanto, tomará um cordeiro para expiação da culpa em oferta de movimento, para fazer expiação por ele, e a dízima de flor de farinha, amassada com azeite, para oferta de alimentos, e um logue de azeite,

verses.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְהָאֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·tê ṯō·rîm ’ōw šə·nê bə·nê yō·w·nāh ’ă·šer taś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw wə·hā·yāh ’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons whichever he can afford . . . one to be a sin offering and the other a burnt offering
verses.literalPt: E duas rolas, ou dois pombinhos, conforme as suas posses, dos quais um será para expiação do pecado, e o outro para holocausto.

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜ם בַּיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֛י לְטָהֳרָת֖וֹ אֶל־ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל־ פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî ’ō·ṯām bay·yō·wm haš·šə·mî·nî lə·ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw ’el- hak·kō·hên ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel- mō·w·‘êḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: On the eighth day he is to bring them for his cleansing to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E ao oitavo dia da sua purificação os trará ao sacerdote, à porta da tenda da congregação, perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֧ח הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־ לֹ֣ג הַשָּׁ֑מֶן וְהֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧ם הַכֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ke·ḇeś hā·’ā·šām wə·’eṯ- lōḡ haš·šā·men wə·hê·nîp̄ ’ō·ṯām hak·kō·hên tə·nū·p̄āh lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The priest shall take the lamb for the guilt offering along with the log of olive oil and wave them . . . as a wave offering before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote tomará o cordeiro da expiação da culpa, e o logue de azeite, e os oferecerá por oferta movida perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְשָׁחַט֮ אֶת־ כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָֽאָשָׁם֒ וְלָקַ֤ח הַכֹּהֵן֙ מִדַּ֣ם הָֽאָשָׁ֔ם וְנָתַ֛ן עַל־ תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־ הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ke·ḇeś hā·’ā·šām wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dam hā·’ā·šām wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- tə·nūḵ ’ō·zen- ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen yā·ḏōw hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen raḡ·lōw hay·mā·nîṯ
verses.literal: And after he slaughters the lamb for the guilt offering the priest is to take some of the blood of the guilt offering and put it on the right earlobe . . . of the one to be cleansed on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot
verses.literalPt: Então degolará o cordeiro da expiação da culpa, e o sacerdote tomará do sangue da expiação da culpa, e o porá sobre a ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e sobre o dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e sobre o dedo polegar do seu pé direito.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן יִצֹ֣ק הַכֹּהֵ֑ן עַל־ כַּ֥ף הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַשְּׂמָאלִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- haš·še·men yi·ṣōq hak·kō·hên ‘al- kap̄ hak·kō·hên haś·śə·mā·lîṯ
verses.literal: Then the priest is to pour some of the oil into his left palm
verses.literalPt: Também o sacerdote derramará do azeite na palma da sua própria mão esquerda.

verses.original: וְהִזָּ֤ה הַכֹּהֵן֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֣וֹ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־ כַּפּ֖וֹ הַשְּׂמָאלִ֑ית שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiz·zāh hak·kō·hên bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw hay·mā·nîṯ min- haš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap·pōw haś·śə·mā·lîṯ še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: and sprinkle with his right forefinger some of the oil in his left palm seven times before the LORD
verses.literalPt: Depois o sacerdote com o seu dedo direito espargirá do azeite que está na sua mão esquerda, sete vezes perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֣מֶן׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ כַּפּ֗וֹ עַל־ תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַמִּטַּהֵר֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִ֑ית עַל־ מְק֖וֹם דַּ֥ם הָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan hak·kō·hên min- haš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap·pōw ‘al- tə·nūḵ ’ō·zen ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen yā·ḏōw hay·mā·nîṯ wə·‘al- bō·hen raḡ·lōw hay·mā·nîṯ ‘al- mə·qō·wm dam hā·’ā·šām
verses.literal: The priest shall also put some of the oil in his palm on the right earlobe . . . of the one to be cleansed on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot on the same places as the blood of the guilt offering
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote porá do azeite que está na sua mão na ponta da orelha direita daquele que tem de purificar-se, e no dedo polegar da sua mão direita, e no dedo polegar do seu pé direito; no lugar do sangue da expiação da culpa.

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֗ר מִן־ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ כַּ֣ף הַכֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַמִּטַּהֵ֑ר לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖יו לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nō·w·ṯār min- haš·še·men ’ă·šer ‘al- kap̄ hak·kō·hên yit·tên ‘al- rōš ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr lə·ḵap·pêr ‘ā·lāw lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The rest of the oil in his palm the priest is to put on the head of the one to be cleansed to make atonement for him before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E o que sobejar do azeite que está na mão do sacerdote porá sobre a cabeça daquele que tem de purificar-se, para fazer expiação por ele perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־ הָֽאֶחָד֙ מִן־ הַתֹּרִ֔ים א֖וֹ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י הַיּוֹנָ֑ה מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ min- hat·tō·rîm ’ōw min- bə·nê hay·yō·w·nāh mê·’ă·šer taś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Then he must sacrifice - the turtledoves or . . . young pigeons whichever he can afford . . .
verses.literalPt: Depois oferecerá uma das rolas ou um dos pombinhos, conforme suas posses,

verses.original: אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־ תַּשִּׂ֞יג יָד֗וֹ אֶת־ הָאֶחָ֥ד חַטָּ֛את וְאֶת־ הָאֶחָ֥ד עֹלָ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּנְחָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַ֥ל הַמִּטַּהֵ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ ’ă·šer- taś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·’eṯ- hā·’e·ḥāḏ ‘ō·lāh ‘al- ham·min·ḥāh wə·ḵip·per hak·kō·hên ‘al ham·miṭ·ṭa·hêr lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: - - one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering together with the grain offering In this way the priest will make atonement before the LORD for the one to be cleansed
verses.literalPt: Sim, conforme as suas posses, será um para expiação do pecado e o outro para holocausto com a oferta de alimentos; e assim o sacerdote fará expiação por aquele que tem de purificar-se perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֔ת אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֖וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־ תַשִּׂ֥יג יָד֖וֹ בְּטָהֳרָתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: zōṯ tō·w·raṯ ’ă·šer- bōw ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·rā·‘aṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṯaś·śîḡ yā·ḏōw bə·ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw
verses.literal: This is the law for someone who has . . . . . . a skin disease and cannot afford . . . the cost of his cleansing
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei daquele em quem estiver a praga da lepra, cujas posses não lhe permitirem o devido para purificação.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . . and Aaron . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés e a Arão, dizendo:

verses.original: כִּ֤י תָבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶ֖ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֑ה וְנָתַתִּי֙ נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת בְּבֵ֖ית אֶ֥רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an ’ă·šer ’ă·nî nō·ṯên lā·ḵem la·’ă·ḥuz·zāh wə·nā·ṯat·tî ne·ḡa‘ ṣā·ra·‘aṯ bə·ḇêṯ ’e·reṣ ’ă·ḥuz·zaṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land of Canaan which I am giving you as your possession and I put a contamination of mildew into a house in that land
verses.literalPt: Quando tiverdes entrado na terra de Canaã que vos hei de dar por possessão, e eu enviar a praga da lepra em alguma casa da terra da vossa possessão,

verses.original: וּבָא֙ אֲשֶׁר־ ל֣וֹ הַבַּ֔יִת וְהִגִּ֥יד לַכֹּהֵ֖ן לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּנֶ֕גַע נִרְאָ֥ה לִ֖י בַּבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā ’ă·šer- lōw hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hig·gîḏ lak·kō·hên lê·mōr kə·ne·ḡa‘ nir·’āh lî bab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: the owner of the house shall come and tell the priest . . . Something like mildew has appeared in my house
verses.literalPt: Então aquele, de quem for a casa, virá e informará ao sacerdote, dizendo: Parece-me que há como que praga em minha casa.

verses.original: וְצִוָּ֨ה הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וּפִנּ֣וּ אֶת־ הַבַּ֗יִת בְּטֶ֨רֶם יָבֹ֤א הַכֹּהֵן֙ לִרְא֣וֹת אֶת־ הַנֶּ֔גַע וְלֹ֥א יִטְמָ֖א כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּבָּ֑יִת וְאַ֥חַר כֵּ֛ן יָבֹ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh hak·kō·hên ū·p̄in·nū ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ṭe·rem yā·ḇō hak·kō·hên lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ wə·lō yiṭ·mā kāl- ’ă·šer bab·bā·yiṯ wə·’a·ḥar kên yā·ḇō hak·kō·hên lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: The priest must order that the house be cleared before he enters it to examine the mildew so that nothing . . . in the house will become unclean After this the priest shall go in to inspect the house
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote ordenará que desocupem a casa, antes que entre para examinar a praga, para que tudo o que está na casa não seja contaminado; e depois entrará o sacerdote, para examinar a casa;

verses.original: וְרָאָ֣ה אֶת־ הַנֶּ֗גַע וְהִנֵּ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בְּקִירֹ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת שְׁקַֽעֲרוּרֹת֙ יְרַקְרַקֹּ֔ת א֖וֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּ֑ת וּמַרְאֵיהֶ֥ן שָׁפָ֖ל מִן־ הַקִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’āh ’eṯ- han·ne·ḡa‘ wə·hin·nêh han·ne·ḡa‘ bə·qî·rōṯ hab·ba·yiṯ šə·qa·‘ă·rū·rōṯ yə·raq·raq·qōṯ ’ōw ’ă·ḏam·dam·mōṯ ū·mar·’ê·hen šā·p̄āl min- haq·qîr
verses.literal: He is to examine the house and if the mildew on the walls consists of green or red depressions that appear to be beneath . . . the surface of the wall
verses.literalPt: E, vendo a praga, e eis que se ela estiver nas paredes da casa em covinhas verdes ou vermelhas, e parecerem mais fundas do que a parede,

verses.original: וְיָצָ֧א הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מִן־ הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבָּ֑יִת וְהִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ṣā hak·kō·hên min- hab·ba·yiṯ ’el- pe·ṯaḥ hab·bā·yiṯ wə·his·gîr ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: the priest . . . shall go outside - the doorway of the house and close it up for seven days
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote sairá da casa para fora da porta, e fechá-la-á por sete dias.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֥ב הַכֹּהֵ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בְּקִירֹ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šāḇ hak·kō·hên bay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î wə·rā·’āh wə·hin·nêh pā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bə·qî·rōṯ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: On the seventh day the priest is to return and inspect the house If the mildew has spread on the walls
verses.literalPt: Depois, ao sétimo dia o sacerdote voltará, e examinará; e se vir que a praga nas paredes da casa se tem estendido,

verses.original: וְצִוָּה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְחִלְּצוּ֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּהֵ֖ן הַנָּ֑גַע וְהִשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אֶתְהֶן֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣiw·wāh hak·kō·hên wə·ḥil·lə·ṣū ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ’ă·šer bā·hên han·nā·ḡa‘ wə·hiš·lî·ḵū ’eṯ·hen ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’el- mā·qō·wm ṭā·mê
verses.literal: he must order that the contaminated stones be pulled out and thrown into an unclean place outside the city . . .
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote ordenará que arranquem as pedras, em que estiver a praga, e que as lancem fora da cidade, num lugar imundo;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַבַּ֛יִת יַקְצִ֥עַ מִבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֑יב וְשָׁפְכ֗וּ אֶת־ הֶֽעָפָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְצ֔וּ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ yaq·ṣi·a‘ mib·ba·yiṯ sā·ḇîḇ wə·šā·p̄ə·ḵū ’eṯ- he·‘ā·p̄ār ’ă·šer hiq·ṣū ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’el- mā·qō·wm ṭā·mê
verses.literal: And he shall have the inside of the house scraped completely and the plaster that is scraped off dumped into an unclean place outside the city . . .
verses.literalPt: E fará raspar a casa por dentro ao redor, e o pó que houverem raspado lançarão fora da cidade, num lugar imundo;

verses.original: וְלָקְחוּ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים אֲחֵר֔וֹת וְהֵבִ֖יאוּ אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְעָפָ֥ר אַחֵ֛ר יִקַּ֖ח וְטָ֥ח אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qə·ḥū ’ă·ḇā·nîm ’ă·ḥê·rō·wṯ wə·hê·ḇî·’ū ’el- ta·ḥaṯ hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·‘ā·p̄ār ’a·ḥêr yiq·qaḥ wə·ṭāḥ ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: So different stones must be obtained to replace . . . . . . the contaminated ones as well as additional mortar to replaster the house
verses.literalPt: Depois tomarão outras pedras, e as porão no lugar das primeiras pedras; e outro barro se tomará, e a casa se rebocará.

verses.original: וְאִם־ יָשׁ֤וּב הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ וּפָרַ֣ח בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחַ֖ר חִלֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ הָאֲבָנִ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵ֛י הִקְצ֥וֹת אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וְאַחֲרֵ֥י הִטּֽוֹחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- yā·šūḇ han·ne·ḡa‘ ū·p̄ā·raḥ bab·ba·yiṯ ’a·ḥar ḥil·lêṣ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê hiq·ṣō·wṯ ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·’a·ḥă·rê hiṭ·ṭō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: If the mildew . . . reappears in the house after the stones have been torn out and the house . . . has been scraped and replastered
verses.literalPt: Porém, se a praga tornar a brotar na casa, depois de arrancadas as pedras e raspada a casa, e de novo rebocada,

verses.original: וּבָא֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאָ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַנֶּ֖גַע בַּבָּ֑יִת צָרַ֨עַת מַמְאֶ֥רֶת הִ֛וא בַּבַּ֖יִת טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā hak·kō·hên wə·rā·’āh wə·hin·nêh pā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bab·bā·yiṯ ṣā·ra·‘aṯ mam·’e·reṯ hî bab·ba·yiṯ ṭā·mê hū
verses.literal: the priest must come and inspect it If the mildew has spread in the house it is a destructive mildew the house is unclean . . .
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote entrará e examinará, se a praga na casa se tem estendido, lepra roedora há na casa; imunda está.

verses.original: וְנָתַ֣ץ אֶת־ הַבַּ֗יִת אֶת־ אֲבָנָיו֙ וְאֶת־ עֵצָ֔יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ עֲפַ֣ר הַבָּ֑יִת וְהוֹצִיא֙ אֶל־ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר אֶל־ מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯaṣ ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇā·nāw wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ṣāw wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ă·p̄ar hab·bā·yiṯ wə·hō·w·ṣî ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’el- mā·qō·wm ṭā·mê
verses.literal: It must be torn down with its stones its timbers and all its plaster and taken outside the city . . . to an unclean place
verses.literalPt: Portanto se derribará a casa, as suas pedras, e a sua madeira, como também todo o barro da casa; e se levará para fora da cidade a um lugar imundo.

verses.original: וְהַבָּא֙ אֶל־ הַבַּ֔יִת כָּל־ יְמֵ֖י הִסְגִּ֣יר אֹת֑וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד־ הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hab·bā ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ kāl- yə·mê his·gîr ’ō·ṯōw yiṭ·mā ‘aḏ- hā·‘ā·reḇ
verses.literal: Anyone who enters . . . the house during any of the days that it is closed up will be unclean until evening
verses.literalPt: E o que entrar naquela casa, em qualquer dia em que estiver fechada, será imundo até à tarde.

verses.original: וְהַשֹּׁכֵ֣ב בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֑יו וְהָאֹכֵ֣ל בַּבַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת־ בְּגָדָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wə·haš·šō·ḵêḇ bab·ba·yiṯ yə·ḵab·bês ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw wə·hā·’ō·ḵêl bab·ba·yiṯ yə·ḵab·bês ’eṯ- bə·ḡā·ḏāw
verses.literal: And anyone who sleeps in the house - or eats in it must wash his clothes
verses.literalPt: Também o que se deitar a dormir em tal casa, lavará as suas roupas; e o que comer em tal casa lavará as suas roupas.

verses.original: וְאִם־ בֹּ֨א יָבֹ֜א הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְרָאָה֙ וְ֠הִנֵּה לֹא־ פָשָׂ֤ה הַנֶּ֙גַע֙ בַּבַּ֔יִת אַחֲרֵ֖י הִטֹּ֣חַ אֶת־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְטִהַ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת כִּ֥י נִרְפָּ֖א הַנָּֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- bō yā·ḇō hak·kō·hên wə·rā·’āh wə·hin·nêh lō- p̄ā·śāh han·ne·ḡa‘ bab·ba·yiṯ ’a·ḥă·rê hiṭ·ṭō·aḥ ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ wə·ṭi·har hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ kî nir·pā han·nå̄·ḡaʿ
verses.literal: If, however the priest comes . . . and inspects it and the mildew has not spread after the house has been replastered he shall pronounce the house clean because the mildew is gone
verses.literalPt: Porém, tornando o sacerdote a entrar na casa e examinando-a, se a praga não se tem estendido, depois que a casa foi rebocada, o sacerdote a declarará por limpa, porque a praga está curada.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֛ח לְחַטֵּ֥א אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת שְׁתֵּ֣י צִפֳּרִ֑ים וְעֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּשְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְאֵזֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ lə·ḥaṭ·ṭê ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ šə·tê ṣip·po·rîm wə·‘êṣ ’e·rez ū·šə·nî ṯō·w·la·‘aṯ wə·’ê·zōḇ
verses.literal: He is to take two birds cedar wood scarlet yarn . . . and hyssop to purify the house
verses.literalPt: Depois tomará, para expiar a casa, duas aves, e pau de cedro, e carmesim e hissopo;

verses.original: וְשָׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הָאֶחָ֑ת אֶל־ כְּלִי־ חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל־ מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣip·pōr hā·’e·ḥāṯ ’el- kə·lî- ḥe·reś ‘al- ma·yim ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: and he shall slaughter one of the birds over fresh water in a clay . . . pot
verses.literalPt: E degolará uma ave num vaso de barro sobre águas correntes;

verses.original: וְלָקַ֣ח אֶת־ עֵֽץ־ הָ֠אֶרֶז וְאֶת־ הָ֨אֵזֹ֜ב וְאֵ֣ת׀ שְׁנִ֣י הַתּוֹלַ֗עַת וְאֵת֮ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽחַיָּה֒ וְטָבַ֣ל אֹתָ֗ם בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַשְּׁחוּטָ֔ה וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וְהִזָּ֥ה אֶל־ הַבַּ֖יִת שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ ’eṯ- ‘êṣ- hā·’e·rez wə·’eṯ- hā·’ê·zōḇ wə·’êṯ šə·nî hat·tō·w·la·‘aṯ wə·’êṯ haṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh wə·ṭā·ḇal ’ō·ṯām bə·ḏam haṣ·ṣip·pōr haš·šə·ḥū·ṭāh ū·ḇam·ma·yim ha·ḥay·yîm wə·hiz·zāh ’el- hab·ba·yiṯ še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: Then he shall take the cedar wood the hyssop the scarlet yarn . . . and the live bird dip them in the blood of the slaughtered bird and the fresh water and sprinkle . . . the house seven times
verses.literalPt: Então tomará pau de cedro, e o hissopo, e o carmesim, e a ave viva, e os molhará no sangue da ave degolada e nas águas correntes, e espargirá a casa sete vezes;

verses.original: וְחִטֵּ֣א אֶת־ הַבַּ֔יִת בְּדַם֙ הַצִּפּ֔וֹר וּבַמַּ֖יִם הַֽחַיִּ֑ים וּבַצִּפֹּ֣ר הַחַיָּ֗ה וּבְעֵ֥ץ הָאֶ֛רֶז וּבָאֵזֹ֖ב וּבִשְׁנִ֥י הַתּוֹלָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥiṭ·ṭê ’eṯ- hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ḏam haṣ·ṣip·pō·wr ū·ḇam·ma·yim ha·ḥay·yîm ū·ḇaṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh ū·ḇə·‘êṣ hā·’e·rez ū·ḇā·’ê·zōḇ ū·ḇiš·nî hat·tō·w·lā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: And he shall cleanse the house with the bird’s blood the fresh water the live bird the cedar wood the hyssop and the scarlet yarn . . .
verses.literalPt: Assim expiará aquela casa com o sangue da ave, e com as águas correntes, e com a ave viva, e com o pau de cedro, e com o hissopo, e com o carmesim.

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֞ח אֶת־ הַצִּפֹּ֧ר הַֽחַיָּ֛ה אֶל־ מִח֥וּץ לָעִ֖יר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עַל־ הַבַּ֖יִת וְטָהֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šil·laḥ ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣip·pōr ha·ḥay·yāh ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr ’el- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh wə·ḵip·per ‘al- hab·ba·yiṯ wə·ṭā·hêr
verses.literal: Finally, he is to release the live bird into the open fields outside the city . . . In this way he will make atonement for the house and it will be clean
verses.literalPt: Então soltará a ave viva para fora da cidade, sobre a face do campo; assim fará expiação pela casa, e será limpa.

verses.original: זֹ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֑ה לְכָל־ נֶ֥גַע הַצָּרַ֖עַת וְלַנָּֽתֶק׃
verses.transliteration: zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh lə·ḵāl ne·ḡa‘ haṣ·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ wə·lan·nā·ṯeq
verses.literal: This is the law for any infectious skin disease . . . for a scaly outbreak
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lei de toda a praga da lepra, e da tinha,

verses.original: וּלְצָרַ֥עַת הַבֶּ֖גֶד וְלַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ṣā·ra·‘aṯ hab·be·ḡeḏ wə·lab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: for mildew in clothing or in a house
verses.literalPt: E da lepra das roupas, e das casas,

verses.original: וְלַשְׂאֵ֥ת וְלַסַּפַּ֖חַת וְלַבֶּהָֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·laś·’êṯ wə·las·sap·pa·ḥaṯ wə·lab·be·hā·reṯ
verses.literal: and for a swelling rash or spot
verses.literalPt: E da inchação, e das pústulas, e das manchas lustrosas;

verses.original: לְהוֹרֹ֕ת בְּי֥וֹם הַטָּמֵ֖א וּבְי֣וֹם הַטָּהֹ֑ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַצָּרָֽעַת׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·hō·w·rōṯ bə·yō·wm haṭ·ṭā·mê ū·ḇə·yō·wm haṭ·ṭā·hōr zōṯ tō·w·raṯ haṣ·ṣā·rā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: to determine when . . . something is clean or unclean This is the law regarding skin diseases and mildew
verses.literalPt: Para ensinar quando alguma coisa será imunda, e quando será limpa. Esta é a lei da lepra.
